notes.title: Shattering minor bugs!
notes.content:
Just a quick update fixing a couple of issues:
Empty profile names are no longer possible, when you attempt to play with an empty profile you'll be prompted to enter a name. This will ensure you don't lose progress!
Losing connection to Steam will no longer cause gameplay issues. (While we don't officially support Linux, this should make the game more stable in things like Proton. Thanks FVN!)
The Pierce powerup will be able to pierce immediately if the powerup is triggered while the ball is outside the slowdown area. This is super minor, but seemed unfair to us after watching some tweeted replays
